regions.merged_text: Fr. Innocent from Harlem and Fr. Venantius from "Our Lady of Sorrows accompanied Fr. Paul to Yonkers, A Capuchin Missionary from the Alutian Islands. This Fr. Paul was to be celebrant at the Corpus Christi Celebration held the day before. - but was delayed. He looks much like Fr. Bonaventure Fray looked in his younger days. Humble and zealous though over six feet tall and of noble appearance he makes a good impression.
